title: CAT DASH
oneLiner: Leap over charging dogs and keep your speedy cat running forever!
mechanics: The cat automatically runs across a scrolling street.
Press A to jump over dogs and other hazards.
Clear dogs to earn points; longer runs increase the score multiplier.
The game speeds up and hazards appear more often over time.

controls.b: Pounce briefly; clears small obstacles but cannot defeat dogs

lose: The cat loses when it hits a dog or obstacle.
scoring: Score points for distance traveled and successful dog jumps.
